name: Cholleti Sucheer

projects.name: TruthGuard — Agentic RAG Pipeline
projects.description: Stateful multi-agent RAG system using LangGraph with 7 role-based agents for temporally-aware legal and regulatory QA. Hybrid retrieval using BM25, FAISS, ColBERT with cross-encoder reranking. Has a pending research publication.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Debate System
projects.description: Stateful multi-agent debate system using LangGraph with role-based agents (Scientist, Philosopher, Judge) and LLaMA 3.2 via LangChain-Ollama. Includes semantic similarity scoring and production-grade validation.

projects.name: Top-K Stock Ranking Using GNNs (FinGAT)
projects.description: Graph-based stock ranking model using GATv2 capturing relational dependencies across Indian stocks and S&P 500. 32+ engineered features, 73% baseline accuracy.

projects.name: Fraud Detection Using Graph Learning and RL
projects.description: Fraud detection combining TSSGC with DQN-based decision optimization for transaction networks. Used SMOTE for class imbalance and KNN-based graph representations.

projects.name: Stale Fruit Detection System
projects.description: Two-stage computer vision pipeline using CNN filtering followed by ViT and Swin Transformer for fruit freshness classification. Deployed as interactive web app with Streamlit/Gradio.

experience.description: Integrated AI-powered backend endpoint with Worker to fetch and summarize notices dynamically. Built trigger-based UI feature using AI Worker service for real-time notice aggregation. Connected frontend to deployed AI Backend Worker for on-demand data retrieval.
